title: Continuity drift reaches Engram before the no-edit turn's checkpoint (re-audit of the inter-turn path)
outcome: Continuity drift reaches Engram before the no-edit turn's checkpoint (re-audit of the inter-turn path)
acceptance: When a workspace's measured begin basis differs from the previous checkpoint's end basis for the same workspace and binding, the difference reaches the store as the inter_turn_change execution_observe recorded before the next turn's provider handoff, and that turn's checkpoint reporting source_changed=false is recorded after it, so the store explains the change the no-edit turn did not make. A test drives drift followed by a no-edit turn and shows the inter_turn_change, its accounted receipt and the source_changed=false checkpoint in that order, and shows no observation when nothing changed.
Every drift case the re-audit finds the inter-turn path does not report is either reported through inter_turn_change with a test, or filed as its own item with its reason, cited in this item's notes.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
